tests.name: Restaurant Admin explains that kiosk management is ready and where a terminal key is entered
A failed key request keeps the form, error and entered details
Submitting creates a real branch-specific support request without leaving kiosk setup
Request replies are available in place with a direct return to setup
Customer kiosk opens with Restaurant ID and branch only, never the key
Wrong-app and wrong-branch keys are explained and remain unused
A real issued kiosk key activates the touchscreen and Check connection finds its terminal
Fleet failure is visible and retry restores the list instead of claiming no terminals
Appearance shortcut and mobile setup work with the existing admin session
Additional kiosks can request separate keys with explicit duplicate protection
